units: Taan. 10ᵃ (play on חשר̇ת, II Sam. XXII, 12, a. חשב̇ת, Ps. XVIII, 12) [read as Ms. M. 2:] שקול … וקרי ביה הַכְשָׁרַת מים take the Kaf and add it to the Resh and read hakhsharath mayim, sweetening of the waters. [Ed. only הכשר׳, Ms. M. 1 ח׳, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note. As to the interchange for homiletical purposes between ח a. ה, v. ה״א.]
